description: neo4j-memory: automatic recall and capture against a Neo4j Agent Memory graph.
_interpreter: The default 'python' is correct on Windows, where the python.org installer
provides it. On Debian, Ubuntu, and recent macOS there is often only
'python3', so those users set NEO4J_MEMORY_PYTHON=python3 (or the full path
to an interpreter) once, and every hook follows.
Handlers are spawned directly rather than through a shell, so the
interpreter is resolved via PATH by the spawn itself -- a PATH that is
Claude Code's, not your terminal's. scripts/doctor.py checks this.
